analysis.window_description: Fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window (22 x 22 cells at 90 m) centred on the candidate/ROI coordinate, in a local metric CRS.
analysis.crs_policy: All metrics are computed in a projected CRS whose horizontal units are metres. Slopes are never computed from longitude/latitude degrees.

features.label: Mean slope
features.description: Mean terrain gradient angle over the analysis window.
features.method: DEM resampled (bilinear) to 90 m in a metric CRS; per-cell gradient magnitude from a 3x3 Horn operator; arithmetic mean of valid cells.
features.scale_rationale: Fixed a-priori contrast scale: 10 degrees separates smooth plains from rugged hillslopes at 90 m sampling.
features.missing_policy: Candidates missing this metric are excluded from a search that requests it.
features.spatial_support: fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window; 22 x 22 cells at 90 m
features.temporal_support: static epoch of the source DEM release
features.comparability_gate: Same method_version, projected metric CRS, 90 m analysis grid and valid-data rule. Terrain-shape comparability does not imply environmental equivalence.

features.label: 90th percentile slope
features.description: 90th percentile of per-cell terrain gradient angle in the analysis window.
features.method: Same gradient grid as slope_mean_deg; linear-interpolated 90th percentile over valid cells.
features.scale_rationale: Fixed a-priori contrast scale of 15 degrees for steep-tail terrain.
features.missing_policy: Candidates missing this metric are excluded from a search that requests it.
features.spatial_support: fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window; 22 x 22 cells at 90 m
features.temporal_support: static epoch of the source DEM release
features.comparability_gate: Same method_version, projected metric CRS, 90 m analysis grid and valid-data rule. Terrain-shape comparability does not imply environmental equivalence.

features.label: Terrain relief (p95-p05)
features.description: Difference between the 95th and 5th percentile elevation inside the analysis window.
features.method: DEM resampled (bilinear) to 90 m; linear-interpolated percentiles over valid cells; p95 minus p05.
features.scale_rationale: Fixed a-priori contrast scale: 200 m of relief separates subdued from strongly dissected terrain.
features.missing_policy: Candidates missing this metric are excluded from a search that requests it.
features.spatial_support: fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window; 22 x 22 cells at 90 m
features.temporal_support: static epoch of the source DEM release
features.comparability_gate: Same method_version, projected metric CRS, 90 m analysis grid and valid-data rule. Terrain-shape comparability does not imply environmental equivalence.

features.label: Detrended roughness (std dev)
features.description: Standard deviation of elevation residuals after removing a least-squares plane fitted across the analysis window.
features.method: DEM resampled (bilinear) to 90 m in a metric CRS; least-squares plane z = a*x + b*y + c fitted on valid cells; population standard deviation of residuals.
features.scale_rationale: Fixed a-priori contrast scale of 20 m of detrended residual height.
features.missing_policy: Candidates missing this metric are excluded from a search that requests it.
features.spatial_support: fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window; 22 x 22 cells at 90 m
features.temporal_support: static epoch of the source DEM release
features.comparability_gate: Same method_version, projected metric CRS, 90 m analysis grid and valid-data rule. Terrain-shape comparability does not imply environmental equivalence.

features.label: Flat terrain fraction
features.description: Fraction of valid Horn slope cells strictly below 5 degrees.
features.method: Same 90 m Horn 3x3 gradient grid; count(slope < 5 degrees) / count(valid slope). Incomplete neighborhoods and outer rim excluded, never filled.
features.scale_rationale: Fixed engineering contrast of 25 percentage points; not calibrated to physical environmental equivalence.
features.missing_policy: Candidates missing this metric are excluded from a search that requests it.
features.spatial_support: fixed 1.98 km x 1.98 km window; 22 x 22 cells at 90 m
features.temporal_support: static epoch of the source DEM release
features.comparability_gate: Same method_version, projected metric CRS, 90 m analysis grid and valid-data rule. Terrain-shape comparability does not imply environmental equivalence.

distance.name: weighted normalized Euclidean distance
distance.formula: distance = sqrt( sum_i[ w_i * ((candidate_i - target_i) / scale_i)^2 ] / sum_i w_i )
distance.scale_source: feature_registry.scale (fixed, not derived from the result subset)
distance.range: >= 0; lower is more similar. Not a percentage and not a physical equivalence claim.

coverage.label: indexed_subset
coverage.disclaimer: Results are the best matches among the indexed Earth windows only. This is not a global survey and not a base-site recommendation.

coverage.label: indexed_subset
coverage.description: Search is limited to the committed, pre-computed windows listed in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
